scope: Local deterministic cache/concurrency/security, real SDK with fake transport, and actual derivative integrity tests; no hosted mutations

results.name: signed variants coalesce, keep URLs stable, expire before the token, and invalidate
signing failures fail closed and retry without reusing denied signatures
signing work is bounded to four concurrent requests
private preview signatures are reused within a repository and isolated between account-scoped repositories
display derivatives have integrity, preserve proportions and never upscale; originals retain approved hashes
explicit cover file replacement uses immutable uploads, invalidates signatures and never fetches citation URLs
